layout.arrangement: Title centered at top in red text. Below it, one large thin-red-bordered rectangle spans nearly the full slide width and contains a single left-to-right flowchart. The 'Training Data' ellipse sits at the top-left of the box, feeding a curved arrow down into the main horizontal chain of five boxes. Four gray rounded annotation callouts sit below the chain, each aligned under the node it describes. Thin gray strips (video player chrome) run along the very top and bottom edges of the frame, with a small black rectangle at the bottom-left corner.

layout.hierarchy: The red title dominates first, then the flowchart chain of five colored boxes is the visual core (Classification box is the most saturated, dark red with white text, drawing the eye). Annotation callouts are smallest and lightest gray. Arrows are thin red connectors.

visual_elements.description: Linear ML pipeline diagram. Nodes: (1) Ellipse 'Training Data' (two lines: 'Training' / 'Data'), peach fill, thin gray-tan outline, top-left. (2) Rectangle 'Pre processing' (two lines: 'Pre' / 'processing'), light-yellow fill, blue border, bold black text. (3) Rectangle 'Feature Extraction' (two lines: 'Feature' / 'Extraction'), light-cyan fill, blue border, bold black text. (4) Rectangle 'Feature Selection' (two lines: 'Feature' / 'Selection'), pale-green fill, green border, bold black text. (5) Rectangle 'Classification' (one line), dark-red fill, bold WHITE text. (6) Rectangle 'Classifier Output' (two lines: 'Classifier' / 'Output'), tan/brown fill, dark border, bold black text. Arrows (all red, left-to-right unless noted): curved arrow from bottom of 'Training Data' ellipse down into left side of 'Pre processing'; straight arrow 'Pre processing' -> 'Feature Extraction'; straight arrow 'Feature Extraction' -> 'Feature Selection'; straight arrow 'Feature Selection' -> 'Classification'; straight arrow 'Classification' -> 'Classifier Output'. A small white mouse-cursor arrow icon (screen-capture artifact) sits on the arrow between 'Feature Extraction' and 'Feature Selection'.
visual_elements.position: center of slide inside the red-bordered container, ~24-50% vertical

visual_elements.description: Four gray rounded-rectangle annotation callouts with bold black text, each positioned below its related node: (a) 'Based on your inspection You select the techniques' (two lines) under 'Pre processing'; (b) 'Handcrafted features (by You)' (two lines) under 'Feature Extraction', placed slightly lower than the others; (c) 'Your decision And using which approach' (three lines: 'Your decision' / 'And using which' / 'approach') under 'Feature Selection'; (d) 'Apply Model' (two lines: 'Apply' / 'Model') under 'Classification'.
visual_elements.position: lower-middle band, ~52-73% vertical, spread horizontally under the corresponding chain nodes

visual_elements.description: Thin red rectangular border framing the entire diagram area (a drawn rectangle, not a filled shape).

imagery: Small white mouse-pointer/cursor arrow icon overlapping the red arrow between 'Feature Extraction' and 'Feature Selection' — a screen-recording artifact, not slide content (omit or optionally include when recreating).
Thin gray horizontal bars at the very top and very bottom of the frame plus a small black rectangle at bottom-left — video player chrome, not slide content.
typography_notes: All text is bold sans-serif (Verdana/Arial-like). Title is the largest text, bold, red, title-case. Node labels are bold black (white for 'Classification'), roughly 18-20pt equivalent. Annotation callout text is smaller bold black (~12-14pt equivalent). No italics, no all-caps, no numbered or bulleted lists; multi-line labels wrap inside their shapes.
animation_state: No partial build — all six nodes, all arrows, and all four annotation callouts are fully visible. A live mouse cursor is visible mid-slide (between Feature Extraction and Feature Selection), indicating this frame was captured during narration, but nothing appears mid-animation.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF). 2. Add title text box, top-center (~5% from top, full width, centered): 'The Complete ML Classification Process', bold sans-serif, ~32pt, color #CC0000. 3. Draw a rectangle with no fill and a thin red (#CC0000) outline spanning ~7-93% width and ~18-85% height to frame the diagram. 4. Inside, build the flowchart left to right on one horizontal band (~38-50% vertical): (a) Oval at top-left (~8-22% horizontal, ~24-35% vertical), fill #FAD7A0, thin gray-tan outline, text 'Training Data' (wrap to two lines), bold black ~16pt. (b) Rectangle 'Pre processing' (two lines), fill #FFFFCC, border #0000CC ~2pt, bold black text. (c) Rectangle 'Feature Extraction' (two lines), fill #CCFFFF, border #0000CC ~2pt, bold black text. (d) Rectangle 'Feature Selection' (two lines), fill #E7FFE7, border #009900 ~2pt, bold black text. (e) Rectangle 'Classification' (one line), fill #A61C1C, no/light border, bold WHITE text. (f) Rectangle 'Classifier Output' (two lines), fill #D9A96A, dark gray/black border, bold black text. 5. Add red (#CC0000) block arrows: one curved/elbow arrow from the bottom of the 'Training Data' oval down into the left edge of 'Pre processing'; then straight right-pointing arrows connecting Pre processing -> Feature Extraction -> Feature Selection -> Classification -> Classifier Output. 6. Add four rounded rectangles, fill #E0E0E0, no or subtle border, bold black ~12pt text, positioned below the chain: under Pre processing: 'Based on your inspection You select the techniques' (two lines); under Feature Extraction, placed ~10% lower than the others: 'Handcrafted features (by You)' (two lines); under Feature Selection: 'Your decision And using which approach' (three lines); under Classification: 'Apply Model' (two lines). 7. Do NOT add the mouse cursor or the gray video-player strips — those are recording artifacts. 8. Check alignment: all five chain boxes vertically centered on the same axis; each callout horizontally centered under its node.
